comment: On-device transcription (Deja, 2026-11-03; europa ~/asr-bench/RESULT.md sha256 da5bc67f…). The engine (sherpa-onnx-node, Apache-2.0) and the silero VAD are in every package. The speech model and the optional punctuation model come from the 完整版 package, a download (sources below, in order; every file checked against its SHA-256), or the streamer's own copy (U 盘 / a local file, checked the same way). desktop/fetch-asr.cjs fills vendor/asr/ from here for development and packaging.

asr.name: sherpa-onnx-paraformer-zh-2023-09-14 (Paraformer-large, int8)
asr.notThis: sherpa-onnx-paraformer-zh-int8-2025-10-07 is the Sichuan-dialect Paraformer (ASLP-lab/WSChuan-ASR), not this model: never use it.

asrMeta.name: sherpa-onnx-omnilingual-asr-1600-languages-300M-ctc-int8-2025-11-12 (Meta Omnilingual ASR CTC 300M, int8)
asrMeta.license: Apache-2.0 (Copyright 2025 Meta Platforms, Inc.; the archive's LICENSE, sha256 a70a523bafbb595c…; model: github.com/facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr; ONNX export: k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx; checked 2026-11-04)
asrMeta.ramNote: Free memory asked for before Meta's model starts (asr-meta-engine.js): its own process peaked at 888 MB on Windows (i7-11800H, 4 threads) with a 20 s VAD segment, 702 MB over two hours of shorter ones. On Linux (europa) the same model peaked at 2771 MB on a two-hour stream; not explained (docs/validation/2026-11-04-omnilingual-asr/README.md).
asrMeta.note: Optional, chosen in the Transcript tab (the owner, 2026-11-04: Paraformer stays the default, unchanged). One CTC model for 1600+ languages; sherpa-onnx-node 2.0.1 reads it (modelConfig.omnilingual). europa 2026-11-04, 4 threads: the archive's en.wav (3.9 s) in 3.3 s, Paraformer's 0.wav (5.6 s, Mandarin) in 4.7 s; one token per character, each with its time; no punctuation of its own.

consent.note: ADR 2026-11-04 #122 §6 (asr-consent.js): the streamer reads this licence text in the host's box and agrees before anything is downloaded, then picks the site; used only with a consent record on this computer. revision: the Hugging Face commit the hf-mirror source is pinned to (csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-omnilingual-asr-1600-languages-300M-ctc-int8-2025-11-12); the GitHub archive holds the same files (same SHA-256). hf-mirror.com first: the site reachable from mainland China (not tested from there); from a US connection it passes the request on to huggingface.co, which is not a listed host, so that site fails and the streamer is asked again for another.

punct.name: sherpa-onnx-punct-ct-transformer-zh-en-vocab272727-2024-04-12-int8 (CT-Transformer punctuation)
punct.license: Apache-2.0 (model cards: modelscope.cn/models/iic/punc_ct-transformer_zh-cn-common-vocab272727-pytorch and huggingface.co/funasr/ct-punc; neither links FunASR's MODEL_LICENSE; checked 2026-11-03)
punct.sourceNote: The official Hugging Face repo (csukuangfj) has only the 294 MB fp32 model of this punctuation model; the int8 one is only in the k2-fsa GitHub release. ModelScope copies are personal re-uploads and are not used.

devTest.note: The model's own public test sentence (same repo, Apache-2.0), for test/asr-offline.test.js in a checkout only; never packaged.
